subject: BrightBridge — year-end trial top-up and conversion incentive
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: year-end trial top-up & conversion incentive for BrightBridge

Hi Steph / Aditya —

Quick ask as we push to close BrightBridge this quarter. They’re live on a 14-day trial (analytics ingestion + chat assistant) and are asking for a short trial extension plus additional credits to validate peak throughput and a production POC. The opportunity is healthy and the customer has signaled a January rollout contingent on demonstrating stable latency at ~1.2M tokens/day.

What I’d like approval for:
- One-time trial top-up: 25,000 free credits (to be consumed within 30 days)
- Trial window extension: +30 days after current expiry
- A conversion incentive: an additional 10% usage credit applied to the first 3 months post-contract if they sign by 2027-01-15

Why this makes sense: BrightBridge is committed to a pilot budget and is evaluating two vendors. We’re the clear technical favorite but they’ve asked for a cost cushion to run a month-long stress test. This push moves a ~$180k ARR ACV across the line for Q1.

I attached the updated mutual action plan and a proposed approval form (BrightBridge-MAP-v2.pdf). Can we get operations/finance sign-off on the one-time credits + extension? If approved, I’ll scope the offer and send a short amendment to their PO.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: year-end trial top-up & conversion incentive for BrightBridge

Jordan —

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive of a 25k top-up + 30-day extension as a one-time concession to secure the conversion, but two quick asks before I sign off:
1) Can we cap the per-request throughput so they can’t run indefinite load tests while we’re on trial? Suggestion: allow peak burst up to 1.5M tokens/day but throttle sustained to 1.2M/day for the trial period.
2) Need Marissa’s OK on the 10% usage credit structure — finance prefers credits applied as a dollar-value rebate, not ongoing percentage credits.

If Marissa is OK, I’ll draft the amendment language for their PO and include the throughput caps.

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Emma Thompson <emma@brightbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-22T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: year-end trial top-up & conversion incentive for BrightBridge

Jordan —

Appreciate the fast follow. BrightBridge can sign quickly if we have the top-up + extension and a clear path on expected costs once we move to production. A couple notes from our side:
- We will do two heavy load days to simulate month-end ingestion; keeping a peak cap is fine as long as the test isn’t artificially constrained.
- Our procurement lead (procurement@brightbridge.com) needs the amendment + a simple statement of credits and expiration window to attach to the PO.
- Can you confirm that the 10% conversion credit would be shown as a one-time bill credit on the invoice (not a recurring discount)?

If you can send the amendment and the approval form this week we’ll route to procurement and aim to execute before Jan 15.

Thanks — Emma

Emma Thompson
Head of Data Platforms, BrightBridge Systems
emma@brightbridge.com | +1 (617) 555-0233
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-28T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: year-end trial top-up & conversion incentive for BrightBridge

All —

I reviewed the numbers with finance. Approve the following with conditions listed below:
- Approve one-time top-up: 25,000 credits to be consumed within 30 days of issuance.
- Approve trial extension: +30 days from current expiry.
- Approve conversion incentive: equivalent to a one-time $8,000 invoice credit applied to the first post-signature invoice if BrightBridge signs by 2027-01-15.

Conditions:
- Credits must be tracked on the account and expire automatically; no retroactive re-issuance.
- Throughput: allow peak burst up to 1.5M tokens/day for two test days; sustained rate capped at 1.2M tokens/day. Ops will monitor.
- Legal to confirm amendment language; Sales to ensure procurement email thread includes the credit terms verbatim.

I’ve uploaded the signed approval form: approval-form-2026-12-28.pdf (attached). Jordan — proceed to send the amendment and CC procurement.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thompson <emma@brightbridge.com>, procurement@brightbridge.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-29T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Amendment & next steps — BrightBridge trial top-up (approved)

Emma / BrightBridge procurement —

Thanks for the patience. Finance has approved the one-time top-up, extension, and the conversion invoice credit. Attached is the approval form (approval-form-2026-12-28.pdf) and a short amendment that adds:
- 25,000 complimentary credits issued to BrightBridge, valid 30 days from issuance
- Trial window extended by 30 days from current expiry
- One-time $8,000 invoice credit applied to the first invoice after signature if contract executed by 2027-01-15
- Temporary throughput caps for the trial: peak burst up to 1.5M tokens/day for up to two days; sustained cap 1.2M tokens/day

Next steps:
1) Emma / procurement: confirm acceptance of the amendment language and reply with a signed PO or countersigned amendment.
2) Aditya / Jordan: once we receive signed PO we’ll issue the credits and extend the trial window; ops will put the throughput caps in place.
3) Legal: I’ve CC’d Stephanie; please confirm any small wording changes needed.

Emma — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to run through the amendment. If procurement can reply with a yes/no by EOD Friday (2026-12-31) we’ll aim to cut the credits immediately and ensure you have the extra capacity for your two heavy test days.

Cheers — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
